gosa_url.description: Base URL where GOsa will be accessible to users

gosa_data_dir.description: Directory for GOsa runtime data (cache, temporary files)

config_dir.description: Directory where GOsa stores its configuration templates

ldap_base.description: Base DN for all LDAP operations

ldap_bind_dn.description: DN used to bind to LDAP for administrative operations

ldap_bind_password.description: Password for the LDAP bind DN (preferably stored securely via external means)

ldap_schema_version.description: GOsa LDAP schema version to use (must match installed schema)

ldap_tls_verify.description: Verify SSL/TLS certificates when connecting to LDAP over LDAPS

ldap_timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for LDAP operations

default_lang.description: Default language for the GOsa user interface

default_theme.description: Default visual theme for the WebUI

session_timeout.description: User session expiration time in minutes

session_max_users.description: Maximum concurrent sessions per user (0 = unlimited)

password_policy.description: Enforce password complexity rules for new/changed passwords

password_require_upper.description: Require at least one uppercase letter in passwords

password_require_lower.description: Require at least one lowercase letter in passwords

password_require_digit.description: Require at least one digit in passwords

password_require_special.description: Require at least one special character in passwords

smtp_host.description: SMTP server hostname for sending emails

smtp_user.description: SMTP authentication username (leave blank for no auth)

smtp_from.description: From address used in GOsa-generated emails

log_level.description: Verbosity level for main application logs

log_file.description: Path to log file (empty string uses system syslog)

audit_log.description: Enable logging of administrative actions for compliance/forensics

items.description: CIDR notation for allowed admin IP ranges

admin_allowed_ips.description: List of allowed IP ranges for administrative access (empty = all)

admin_allowed_hosts.description: List of allowed hostnames for admin access (empty = all)

tfa_enabled.description: Enable two-factor authentication for admin users

items.description: Supported TFA method (e.g., totp, webauthn, email)

tfa_methods.description: TFA methods allowed for admin accounts

items.description: Name of group to auto-assign to new users

default_groups.description: Groups automatically assigned when a new user is registered

auto_provision.description: Automatically create local GOsa accounts when users authenticate from LDAP

ldap_uid_attr.description: LDAP attribute used as the unique username identifier

ldap_mail_attr.description: LDAP attribute used for email address

ldap_cn_attr.description: LDAP attribute used for full display name

ldap_group_objectclass.description: LDAP objectClass used to identify groups

ldap_group_member_attr.description: LDAP attribute used to list group members

ldap_group_member_mode.description: How group membership is stored: 'dn' (full DN) or 'uid' (short username)

service_account_groups.description: Groups granted elevated privileges for automated tasks

api_enabled.description: Enable the REST API for programmatic access

api_auth_method.description: Authentication method for API requests (session or token)

api_cors_origins.description: List of origins allowed to make cross-origin requests to the API

web_prefix.description: URL path prefix under which WebUI is served (e.g., /gosa)

session_cookie_domain.description: Domain scope for session cookies (empty = current host)

force_https.description: Redirect all HTTP to HTTPS (recommended in production)

maintenance_mode.description: Disable user logins and show maintenance banner

maintenance_message.default: GOsa is currently undergoing scheduled maintenance.
maintenance_message.description: Message displayed to users during maintenance mode

enabled_plugins.description: List of GOsa plugins to enable
